scripts.scaffold: (docker-compose --progress=plain up --build scaffold && docker-compose cp scaffold:/usr/src/app ./app || cd .) && docker-compose down scaffold
scripts.package-lock: (docker-compose --progress=plain up --build package-lock && docker-compose cp package-lock:/usr/src/app/package-lock.json ./app || cd .) && docker-compose down package-lock
scripts.deploy-debug: (docker-compose --progress=plain up --build deploy-debug && node -e "import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises'; await mkdir('./app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug', { recursive: true })" && docker-compose cp deploy-debug:/usr/src/app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug ./app/android/app/build/outputs/apk && (adb uninstall com.slugfiller.hyperproxy || cd .) && adb install ./app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk || cd .) && docker-compose down deploy-debug
scripts.debug: node -e "import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';const env = {...process.env, 'METRO_PORT': process.argv[1] || '8081' };async function exec(command, ...args) {const child = spawn(command, args, { stdio: 'inherit', env }); function sigint() { child.kill('SIGINT'); }; try { process.on('SIGINT', sigint); return await new Promise((resolve) => { child.on('exit', (code) => resolve(code === 0)); }); } finally { process.off('SIGINT', sigint); }  } await exec('adb', 'reverse', 'tcp:8081', 'tcp:' + (process.argv[1] || '8081')) && await exec('docker-compose', '--progress=plain', 'up', '--build', '--watch', 'debug'); await exec('docker-compose', 'down', 'debug'); await exec('adb', 'reverse', '--remove', 'tcp:8081');" --
scripts.generate-keystore: (docker-compose --progress=plain up --build generate-keystore && docker-compose cp generate-keystore:/usr/src/app/android/app/release.keystore ./app/android/app || cd .) && docker-compose down generate-keystore
scripts.release: (docker-compose --progress=plain up --build release && node -e "import { mkdir } from 'node:fs/promises'; await mkdir('./app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release', { recursive: true }); await mkdir('./app/android/app/build/outputs/mapping/release', { recursive: true })" && docker-compose cp release:/usr/src/app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release ./app/android/app/build/outputs/apk && docker-compose cp release:/usr/src/app/android/app/build/outputs/mapping/release ./app/android/app/build/outputs/mapping && (adb uninstall com.slugfiller.hyperproxy || cd .) && adb install ./app/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk || cd .) && docker-compose down release
